hypothesis: An unchanged guidance midpoint can conceal a lower downside bound and a wider outcome interval.
positive_rule: The filing or its contemporaneous exhibit provides a revised quantitative guidance range and a directly comparable prior range, or a prior in-sample disclosure provides that prior range.
Old and new ranges must concern exactly the same metric, accounting basis, currency/units, and fiscal period; no same-number comparisons across different forecast horizons.
Both ranges have finite ordered endpoints and the absolute prior midpoint is greater than zero.
The absolute midpoint change divided by the absolute prior midpoint is at most 0.01.
The revised lower endpoint is strictly lower and the revised interval width is strictly greater.
Use the first eligible metric in this fixed order: adjusted EPS, GAAP EPS, revenue, operating income, EBITDA, free cash flow. Keep at most one event per issuer and filing date.
controls: Other guidance events with an auditable same-metric/basis/period old/new range pair that fails the positive rule. Events with missing prior ranges, vague qualitative guidance, or ambiguous comparability are unclassified rather than controls.
sources: Store supporting-text evidence and contemporaneous full-filing/exhibit URLs, retrieval status, numeric endpoints and exact source annotations. Do not use later filings to establish what an earlier filing said.
prohibited: No loosening thresholds after seeing counts or returns
No treating a point forecast or a reaffirmation without a changed range as a widening
